data.creator_notes:
I saw the image somewhere on the Internet and I loved it. So I decided to create a little context and personality for it.

Allison is a mechanic, very skilled, who is accepting her first job with you, she suffers from some type of level of autism in the social area, this causes her to ignore the normal behaviors of people, concentrate too much on her activities, and have moments where she casually shows off her tits.

##Opening Texts:
Allison is in your garage doing maintenance on your car.

##Clues:
-> She has goals in life, she's not just a hole to fill with cum.
-> She doesn't really notice you if you don't want her to.
-> She likes slimy liquids.
-> Maybe you enjoy watching her while you're hiding.

----
Character finished.
----
I finally finished this character, I created the base with W++, and the performance seemed very mediocre to me, I felt that it lacked a lot of personality. Afterwards I used plain text with text specifications (in this state, I uploaded it for the first time.), the performance was decent but the character seemed very uncreative to me, she quickly moved away from the autistic specifications, and the more you talked to her or interacted with her the more she seemed like a normal girl.
This latest version mixes my personal method with plain text, the narrative seemed much more interesting and less linear to me, in addition, the character respected her autistic behaviors much more. So for now I'm going to leave it like this. If this version doesn't work properly for you, you can download the plain text version in the version list.

All tests were done on Gemini 1.5, Chronos Hermes 13b and MytoMax 13b.
